text: Hello and welcome to the live commentary of the Premier League match between West Ham and Sheffield United at the London Stadium.
West Ham's impressive start to the season has been halted in their last two matches with back-to-back defeats to Manchester City and Liverpool.
The Hammers took 10 points from their opening four games before losing out to City and Liverpool.
David Moyes' men did advance to the next round of the EFL Cup after seeing off Lincoln City during the week.
Given Sheffield United's issues, West Ham will be hopeful of returning to winning ways in the Premier League to regain their momentum.
Sheffield United endured one of their worst matches in their history last time out, suffering a 8-0 hammering at the hands of Newcastle United.
Paul Heckingbottom's men were routed on home soil and need a response to avoid another defeat.
The Blades are rock bottom of the Premier League after taking only one point from their opening six games.
And although it's early in the campaign, the longer the club go without a win, the more the pressure will build on Heckingbottom and his squad.
Moyes made several changes to his side for the EFL Cup clash against Lincoln, but he has reverted back to the same side that was beaten by Liverpool.
Antonio leads the line supported by Bowen, Ward-Prowse and Paqueta.
Alvarez and Soucek sit in front of the back four, while Areola returns to replace Fabianski.
Despite the emphatic nature of their defeat to Newcastle last time out, Heckingbottom makes only one change to his side this afternoon.
Norwood drops out of the team and is replaced by McBurnie, who joins Archer in the final third.
Hamer, McAtee and Vinicius anchor the midfield.
Sheffield United have won just one of their last 10 away league games against West Ham (D4 L5), picking up a 2-0 win in the Championship in January 2005.
We're under way at London Stadium.
West Ham win a corner down the right flank that Ward-Prowse whips into the box.
There's a clash of heads and McBurnie goes down, forcing a stoppage in play.
Paqueta plays a one-two with Soucek on the edge of the Sheffield United box, but Robinson acts to prevent him firing at goal with a desperate challenge.
CHANCE! Bowen gets the better of McAtee down the right flank rolling the midfielder with ease.
He sends a cutback towards Soucek, but the midfielder launches his first-time strike over the top.
Antonio twists and turns down the right flank and forces a cross into the box.
Soucek can only glance his header away from goal before Paqueta hammers a cutback straight at Foderingham.
McAtee drives forward for the Blades and offloads to Bogle on the right flank.
He sends a low cross that fails to beat Aguerd, who clears the danger for the hosts.
BLOCKS! Thomas sends a cross into the box from the left flank that falls for Archer.
He turns to shoot, only to be denied by Aguerd.
Hamer pounces on the loose ball and shoots, but Soucek deflects it over the top.
Paqueta goes for the give and go with Emerson and he bursts down the left flank.
Ahmedhodzic has to act to deflect his cutback behind for a corner.
SAVE AND OFF THE LINE! Ward-Prowse lifts the resulting corner into the box where Bowen heads towards goal.
Foderingham acts to make a reaction save, but the rebound falls to Aguerd to head towards goal.
Robinson is in the right place at the right time to head off the line.
The Blades win the ball high up the field and McBurnie releases Archer with a neat backheel.
The striker shoots on his right foot from 20 yards, only to lift his effort over the top.
Vinicius loses possession in his own half and he trips Bowen on the edge of the Sheffield United box.
Ward-Prowse stands over the ball.
SAVE! Ward-Prowse fires at goal from the edge of the box, but Foderingham watches his effort all the way to make a comfortable stop.
Bogle raids down the right flank and floats a cross into the box, but Ahmedhodzic cannot connect with his header.
The Blades keep the pressure on, but Bogle is flagged offside as he collects an offload from McAtee.
GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!!!!!! BOWEN FINISHES A SUBLIME TEAM MOVE!!!! 1-0 WEST HAM! Bowen puts the Hammers ahead with a composed finish from 12 yards to complete a flowing move.
Bowen starts the attack with an offload to Soucek, who then releases Coufal in acres of space down the right flank.
The right-back produces a fine cutback to fine Bowen in stride in the box and he steers his effort away from Foderingham into the bottom-left corner.
Coufal makes a great run down the right flank and then picks out Bowen with a perfect cutback before the winger does the rest.
Emerson floats a cross towards Antonio in the box.
He fends off one challenge and tries to shoot on the turn, but Egan blocks his strike behind for a corner.
Thomas has a nervy wait for a VAR check for a potential handball from a Ward-Prowse corner, but the decision remains on the field for no penalty to the Hammers.
Alvarez latches onto a loose ball 20 yards from goal and launches a strike towards the target that Foderingham claims with ease.
WIDE! Bowen feeds Antonio and he runs at the Sheffield United defence.
He has support, but goes for the strike alone and blasts his effort wide.
McAtee slides in hard on Soucek and goes into the book.
Coufal sends a throw-in to Bowen in the box.
He works the ball onto his left foot to look for a space to fire at goal, but he places his effort wide of the target.
West Ham work the ball around the edge of the Blades box before Coufal clips a delivery into the middle that Soucek glances wide of the target.
GOALLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL!! SOUCEK MAKES IT TWO!!!! 2-0!!!!!!! The Hammers extend their advantage as Soucek bundles the ball past Foderingham.
Hamer sees his pass out wide intercepted by Emerson, who finds Antonio with his offload.
Antonio spots the run of Soucek in the box and the midfielder manages to get enough power behind his left-footed strike to score before he falls over.
West Ham are in command.
Antonio releases Soucek in the box and the midfielder completes a close-range finish.
CHANCE! McBurnie spurns a huge chance to get the Blades back into the game.
Archer sends a pass to the forward in the right-inside channel and he gets the ball out of his feet, only to drag his effort wide of the target.
Alvarez brings down Bogle in the West Ham half and goes into the book.
Coufal has space down the right flank and digs out a cross for Ward-Prowse to attack, but his header is tame and straight at Foderingham.
Soucek continues to threaten in the final third.
He attacks a deep cross from Emerson to the back post, but Foderingham punches his effort away.
Hamer attacks Bogle's deep cross in the inside-left channel, but his header trickles wide of the post and evades Archer attempting to sneak in behind Aguerd.
There will be three minutes of added time.
West Ham seem content to see out the half with their two-goal advantage intact.
It has been a great first period from Moyes' men.
HALF-TIME: WEST HAM 2-0 SHEFFIELD UNITED
West Ham hold a 2-0 lead over Sheffield United at the break in their Premier League clash.
The home side took the lead through Jarrod Bowen following a sublime team move down the right flank.
Tomas Soucek extended their advantage from a brisk counter after being picked out by Michail Antonio.
The Hammers are in control and are 45 minutes away from returning to winning ways in the Premier League.
Sheffield United have been exposed in both boxes yet again.
They've failed to take their openings as Oli McBurnie and Cameron Archer missed good opportunities, while at the other end they've paid the price for their mistakes.
The second half is a massive test of character for Paul Heckingbottom's team.
We're back under way at London Stadium.
Sheffield United have failed to score a first-half goal in six of their seven games.
Not a great stat for Heckingbottom and his team.
Bowen raids down the right flank and clips a cross into the middle.
Foderingham makes the claim, but loses it briefly.
Fortunately for the keeper, no one in a West Ham shirt is there to capitalise.
Paqueta draws a foul from Bogle on the left flank, but the visitors are able to clear the danger from Ward-Prowse's free-kick.
OVER! Robinson throws the ball long into the box and Egan steers it towards Vinicius.
He tries to place an effort towards goal, but it's deflected over the top.
A concern for the visitors as Egan is down in need of treatment.
He may have to make way here.
Egan is forced off with a leg injury and is replaced at the back by Basham.
CHANCE! Ahmedhodzic connects with a header at the back post, but Areola spreads himself and uses the angle to his benefit to make the stop.
West Ham are playing a patient game and are not forcing the issue with their two-goal advantage.
The Hammers seem content to wait for their moment.
West Ham cut the Blades open at the back as Antonio releases Bowen.
He rounds Foderingham, but the angle takes him away from goal.
Bowen works the ball back to Antonio, but Vinicius closes him down before he can fire at goal.
Ward-Prowse lifts a couple of crosses into the middle from the right flank, but Bowen can only loop his header straight into the hands of Foderingham.
WIDE! Aguerd rises highest in the box from another Ward-Prowse delivery from a corner, only to plant his header inches wide of the target.
Alvarez has to be careful as he catches Bogle and gives away a free-kick.
That could be his final warning.
Davies enters the action to replace McAtee in the Blades midfield.
Hamer probes down the inside-left channel and he tries to force a strike across the face of goal that Aguerd does well to divert behind.
Benrahma comes onto the field to replace Alvarez, which will see Ward-Prowse drop back.
Kudus replaces Antonio in the final third as Bowen moves into the middle.
Although West Ham are in control, the home side have not put the game beyond the reach of the visitors yet.
Moyes will be anxious for his team to kill off the game with a third.
WIDE! McBurnie rises to attack a long throw into the box from the left flank from Robinson, but his glancing effort trickles just wide of the left post.
BLOCK! Archer makes a driving run into the West Ham box and offloads to his right for Bogle to strike, only to see his effort charged down by Emerson.
Ben Slimane is on for Hamer in the Blades midfield.
Trusty enters the action to replace Bogle down the right flank.
Brewster replaces Archer in the final third after a frustrating day.
The Blades continue to press and Davies goes down under pressure from Soucek.
There's no penalty awarded, but McBurnie pounces on the loose ball and sees his effort blocked.
Benrahma twists and turns in the final third and looks for Soucek.
He gets fortunate as Davies' tackle on his team-mate sends the ball straight back to him, but his first-time curling effort travels straight at Foderingham.
WIDE! Davies feeds Slimane on the edge of the box and he turns to curl an effort towards goal that flashes wide of the post.
Sheffield United continue to pour forward in numbers.
Slimane looks for space for a strike before Thomas takes on a drive that is blocked.
It has been the story of their day.
There's a scramble at the other end of the pitch as Benrahma forces a low ball across the face of goal, but the Blades act to prevent Paqueta and Bowen from turning the ball home.
WIDE! Benrahma and Paqueta combine to tee up Bowen in the box, but his left-footed strike is deflected wide of the target.
There will be six minutes of added time.
Soucek rises to connect with Ward-Prowse's corner, but he heads his effort straight at Foderingham.
Bowen makes way for the hosts after another productive game.
Fornals replaces him.
Mavropanos comes on for Paqueta to shore up the West Ham defence for the closing stages.
Fornals breaks down the right flank and looks for a cutback towards Kudus that is deflected away from the forward in the middle.
Slimane collects on the edge of the box and looks for a strike at goal for a consolation, but his effort is tame and straight at Areola.
Vinicius tracks back to prevent Benrahma firing at goal for a potential West Ham third, putting in a great sliding challenge.
FULL-TIME: WEST HAM 2-0 SHEFFIELD UNITED
West Ham get back to winning ways in the Premier League with a 2-0 victory over Sheffield United at London Stadium.
The Hammers scored both goals in the first half as Jarrod Bowen finished a sublime team move before Tomas Soucek bundled the ball home following a quick counter from the hosts.
The Blades put in plenty of effort, but lacked the quality in the final third to trouble David Moyes' men and as a result remain bottom of the Premier League table.
West Ham are next in action next Sunday against Newcastle United at home.
The Blades travel to face Fulham in their next outing next Saturday.
Thanks for joining our commentary.
Until next time, goodbye.
